maya: T-minus 48h: finalizing announce. Need final changelog link + docs URL and confirm canary windows so marketing can schedule posts + webinar invite. cc @sam @leo
sam: Docs links updated (staging): https://docs.redwo od.ai/release/v2.3 — will push prod copy by tomorrow 09:00 PT.
leo: Changelog PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/234. Short blurb ready. Fixed one tiny QA grammar issue.
maya: @jamie can you confirm webinar slot? Also planning a staggered announce: hosted first, then dedicated after ~30m.
jamie: Webinar booked 2026-03-25 10:00 PT. Promo email scheduled to go with publish. Can move to 10:15 if we need longer canary observation.
emily: For inbound routing — leads funnel will point to /launch-leads with tag by model and plan. Need canonical UTM and final docs link for the form.
sam: Proposed canary windows: 1) 10:00-10:15 PT (hosted-only, smoke), 2) 10:30-11:00 PT (wider waves). Canary will auto-fallback to smaller model variant on errors.
deploy-bot: deploy-status: canary scheduled -> 2026-03-25T17:00:00Z jobs/789 queued. Rollout: staged-waves.
leo: Ops note: if latency >200ms sustained for 3m -> rollback to v2.2. Also add a line in the announce email noting staged rollout to reduce confusion.
maya: Marketing will schedule publish for 10:15 PT, social posts queued for +15m, webinar CTA goes live at 10:30 PT. @emily set lead tag to "release-mar25"?
emily: Setting tag now, will include utm_source=announce&utm_campaign=mar25_release and docs link once prod URL is live.
sam: Final changelog snippet for marketing copy: ```- Improved KV cache eviction to reduce tail latency under high concurrency
- New batching heuristic for short prompts (~15% cost reduction)
- Private deployment KMS integration added (beta)```
maya: Nice. I'll drop this into the press doc and update the social brief. @leo can you confirm dashboards and alerts retention?
leo: Confirmed — SLO dashboards pinned, 1h retention for post-release spike window, alerting thresholds in place. I'll keep tracing on for the first 90min.
maya: Cool. Thanks everyone :rocket:
jamie: I'll hold 10min pre-webinar dry-check with product at 09:50 PT.
maya: Copy. If anything changes ping this thread.
__notes: Single-thread Slack export style. Messages are short, in-thread order, include @mentions and a bot message.
